items.html: Now, had Adam HaRishon not sinned with the Tree of Knowledge, he would have been able to raise the worlds, through his prayers on that Sabbath day, to other, much higher ascents, ascent after ascent, with each and every prayer — the evening prayer, the morning prayer, the additional prayer, and the afternoon prayer. We shall not elaborate now on the order of their ascent, but we will mention briefly the last and greatest of all the ascents, which was at the afternoon prayer of the Sabbath, for then they would ascend to the utmost ascent. This means that the world of Atzilut would rise to its first place, which is the place of Adam Kadmon of all the ancients, whose explanation is mentioned by us at great length, and all existence would return to its first root.
